tools.name: pqc_tls_scan
tools.description: Live TLS handshake test of a public domain: X25519MLKEM768 / SecP256r1MLKEM768 post-quantum hybrid key exchange, TLS 1.3, TLS 1.2 and legacy downgrade exposure, certificate key and HSTS. Returns a 0-100 readiness score, Harvest-Now-Decrypt-Later risk and findings.

tools.name: nanoform_reach_check
tools.description: Check a nanomaterial against the EU nanomaterial definition (2022/C 229/01), REACH Annex II (Regulation 2020/878) Safety Data Sheet nanoform requirements and ISO/TR 13014 characterisation coverage. Accepts particle size data (nm), BET surface area, density and optional SDS text.

tools.name: sgrna_qc
tools.description: Heuristic QC for CRISPR guide RNAs (GC%, PAM for SpCas9/SaCas9/Cas12a, poly-T, homopolymers, seed checks), FASTA sequences (GC%, candidate SpCas9 sites), HL7 v2 headers or sample manifests (chain of custody, PHI). Not a substitute for genome-wide off-target search.

tools.name: urdf_validate
tools.description: Validate a URDF robot description (structure, joint limits, inertia plausibility, collision geometry) or generate one from a natural-language spec such as '6-DOF arm with parallel gripper'.

tools.name: openapi_to_mcp_preview
tools.description: Convert an OpenAPI/Swagger spec (JSON/YAML text or URL) or a cURL command into MCP tool definitions, with an AI-agent readiness score and EU AI Act Article 50 transparency notes.

tools.name: battery_passport_check
tools.description: Check an EU battery passport (pasted JSON or a passport/QR resolver URL) against Regulation (EU) 2023/1542: scope for the battery category, unique identifier, Annex XIII public fields, restricted-data exposure, dynamic state-of-health data and carbon footprint. Passports are required from 18 Feb 202

tools.name: cra_disclosure_scan
tools.description: Scan a vendor domain for EU Cyber Resilience Act and UK PSTI vulnerability-handling readiness: RFC 9116 security.txt (Contact, Expires, Policy, Canonical), coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy, CSAF provider metadata, SBOM and support-period statements.

tools.name: green_claims_scan
tools.description: Read a company website for environmental claims and greenwashing risk under EU Directive 2024/825 (from 27 Sep 2026) and the UK CMA Green Claims Code, find evidence and credentials (SBTi, ISO 14001, B Corp, reports), and measure the site's own footprint (green hosting, carbon.txt, page weight, CO2 p

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "green_claims_scan" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Read a company website for environmental claims and greenwashing risk under EU Directive 2024/825 (from 27 Sep 2026) and the UK CMA Green Claims Code, find evid…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: battery_passport_check · Private data: cra_disclosure_scan, green_claims_scan · Public sink: pqc_tls_scan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: battery_passport_check · Private data: cra_disclosure_scan, green_claims_scan · Public sink: pqc_tls_scan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
